name: firecrawl
description: Web crawling and extraction powered by the official Firecrawl MCP server — scrape any URL, crawl whole sites, map URL discovery, run web search, extract structured data with an LLM, drive a headless browser with interact, launch autonomous deep-research agents, and monitor pages for changes. Replaces the need for custom scrapers, proxy rotation, and headless browser orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any website into clean Markdown or structured JSON with the official Firecrawl MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can turn any website into clean, structured data — scraping pages, crawling entire sites, and extracting exactly the information you need. Use it for research, competitive analysis, monitoring competitor pages for changes, or feeding structured web data into your workflows. No more dealing with broken scrapers or captchas: just give your agent a URL and tell it what you need.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this page and summarize the main points for me.
Crawl this website and find all pages related to pricing.
Monitor this page for changes and let me know if something updates.
